translation: Took place in posad Serock, 6 October 1890, 8 PM. Appeared personally Berek [unclear: Kompin/Kolpin], laborer, 65, and Abram Wielkobroda, laborer, 20, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 8 AM died a child of female sex named [unclear: Ryfka] Ochberg, half a year old, daughter of Szmul and [unclear: Bejla Frajda?] nee [unclear: Szelkobroda/Wielkobroda], the Ochberg spouses. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of [unclear: Ryfka] Ochberg this act was read to the declarants and not signed by them, the declarants being illiterate.
